text:
```yaml
name: Stale PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Mark stale pull requests
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been inactive for 15 days and will be marked as stale.
            Please update or close it if it is no longer needed.
          close-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been inactive for 22 days and has been closed due to inactivity.
          days-before-pr-stale: 15
          days-before-pr-close: 7
          stale-pr-label: stale
          exempt-pr-labels: pinned,work-in-progress,on-hold
          days-before-issue-stale: -1
          days-before-issue-close: -1
```
